subject: Hosting eligibility & trial runbook alignment — Aurion Health evaluation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurionhealth.com>, Mike Chen <mchen@aurionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + quick asks on hosting paths and PoC scope

Hi Elena / Mike —

Thanks again for the time earlier — quick recap and a suggested next step so we can lock the trial plan. High level takeaways from our call:

- Primary objective: Validate integrated EHR summarization pipeline (real-time summaries from streaming visit notes) with 95th%-tile latency < 250ms for single-request summaries and acceptable cost per 1k requests.
- Security posture: Aurion would prefer data residency controls and customer-managed keys for PHI.
- Hosting appetite: initial leaning toward Private VPC for long-term, but you wanted to evaluate Dedicated capacity for cost predictability and Hosted API for fastest time-to-value.

Attached: aurion-poc-scope.pdf — my rough scope & proposed success criteria table.

As next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the three PoC lanes to evaluate in parallel (Hosted API quick integration, Dedicated reserved micro-pool, Private VPC dry-run plan).
2) Confirm core success criteria owners (latency, correctness / accuracy, cost, security gating).
3) Confirm target trial start week and any procurement constraints.

Can you please confirm stakeholders who need to be looped for procurement, infosec and SRE? Also, are you able to share a short list of the test dataset (PII/PHI masking notes) so we can validate the residency/KMS workflow up front?

Proposed immediate action: 30-min alignment call on Wed 11 Aug to finalize the trial matrix and calendar. I’ll bring Karthik and Monica (SRE lead) to cover runtime and security runbook.

Thanks —
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[hannah@redwoodinference.com]

[Attachment: aurion-poc-scope.pdf (pdf)]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurionhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mchen@aurionhealth.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@aurionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick asks on hosting paths and PoC scope

Thanks Hannah — good write-up. A few clarifications from our side:

- Security: Priya (Infosec) will lead the KMS and audit requirements. We will need to see proof of KMS integrations and log forwarding to our Splunk instance before we greenlight any data ingress.
- Hosting preference: long-term we want Private VPC, but we’re open to a staged evaluation — Hosted API to validate functionality quickly, Dedicated to validate cost/throughput, then Private VPC for production. We want to understand what minimal set of tests will prove whether Dedicated is acceptable vs needing immediate Private.
- Procurement: Mike (CTO) will own procurement. We will likely need an internal purchase request (I’ll attach it after this thread).

Stakeholders to loop: Mike Chen (CTO), Priya Kapoor (Infosec), Sara Lim (SRE lead, sara.lim@aurionhealth.com).

Can you include in the runbook: a short checklist for KMS rotation, logs ingestion points, and a sample SLA latency test harness? If Redwood can provide a short cost model for Dedicated micro-pools for our expected throughput (~1500 summarizations/day) that would help too.

Thanks — looking forward to Wed.
Elena
Director of Clinical Apps, Aurion Health

[Attachment: aurion-internal-req.pdf (pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@aurionhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mchen@aurionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick asks on hosting paths and PoC scope

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the clear asks. I sketched a pragmatic trial matrix that lets Aurion evaluate all three hosting modes without blocking delivery:

Trial matrix (proposed):
- Week 0 (prep): security questionnaire + KMS onboarding + sample data ingestion validation (no PHI until KMS validated).
- Weeks 1–4 (parallel lanes):
  * Hosted API lane: 2-week integration sprint to validate correctness & latency on small dataset.
  * Dedicated lane: deploy a micro-pool (2x A100 equivalent) for throughput tests and cost modeling.
  * Private VPC dry-run: validate network, KMS and logging ingress (no production data until policy sign-off).
- Weeks 5–8: concentration on final integration, extended load tests, and go/no-go review.

Owners: Karthik (PoC technical lead), Hannah (AE & calendar owner), Monica (SRE / infra runbook), Priya (Infosec sign-off).

Deliverables:
- Runbook (redwood-poc-runbook-v1.pdf) with step-by-step deploys and test harness commands.
- Security checklist (security-checklist-aurion.xlsx) covering KMS, logging, retention and access controls.
- Cost model (ballpark) — I’ll attach a first-pass spreadsheet in the next message.

Notes and constraints:
- We can provision a short-term Dedicated micro-pool for the trial; if procurement needs are long, Redwood can provide a time-limited credit for the Dedicated lane (subject to approvals).
- Private VPC requires some network configuration from Aurion (VPN / peering + firewall rules); we’ll provide a checklist.

Proposed calibration call: Wed 11 Aug 10:30am PT to finalize the calendar and sign-offs.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
